title: Silvia NDE 3086
content: I was in a school trip to Buenos Aires, Argentina with all my schoolmates. The bus driver lost control. The bus derailed and in the fall, I banged my head. When I was able to open my eyes, I saw a very intense blue light. After I saw it far away, I started to pass through a tunnel. At the same time I was walking, I was remembering all the moments I lived with my brother. When I reached again the light, I went through it again and I saw my brother (he died four years ago). I hugged him and after crying for some minutes, he looked at me and told me that I had not to cry for his death. That he died because it was his time and I had to live without laments. That he was fine there and that he was always taking care of me from that place. Suddenly, all started to back down and I was able to open my eyes, I was in the hospital with some doctors looking at me with an amazed face. Then, when I was recovered, they told me that I was in coma for two weeks. They practiced some handling to revive me and that they thought I was dead until I said a name. They came close to me and saw that I opened my eyes. The name I said was my brother's name.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: No Accident. Heart attack Clinical death (cessation of breathing or heart function or brain function) .
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: Normal consciousness and alertness I believe all was normal.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning
elements.Did your vision differ in any way from n: I was able to see the blue light clearly; usually this would be impossible due its excessive brightness.
elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: Yes, and the facts have been checked out
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Yes After I saw the light for the first time in the experience, I passed through a tunnel.
elements.The experience included: Presence of deceased persons | Light | A landscape or city | Life review
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes They were at the end of the tunnel. I knew one but I did not see the others clearly. The one I knew was my brother. He told me to do not cry any more for him. That he died because it was his time and that he was taking care of me from that dimension.
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes It was blue, very intense, and so intense that in real life it would be impossible to see it easily.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm era otra dimension,al final del tunel, luego de pasar la luz, donde estaba mi hermano era un lugar muy bello.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: I felt a deep pain in my heart which was pleasing.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control Because my brother died four years ago. Since then, I started to live my life without any sense. I wanted to leave my studies but my father forced me to continue with them. When I saw my brother in the experience he told me do not live in that way. I learnt that death is not bad. And if we cry for the dead people it's just because we believe that we cannot do anything and also because we feel ourselves defenseless before any attack, but they take care of us from their dimension.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Uncertain I always have been able to feel or see things that are not normal. I have never felt alone even when I am alone. I feel people's energy when they come close to me. I can say things that come to my mind without knowing where I see them but they are real.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real. It changed my mind.
